key_insight: DeliMF combines structured ICU data with clinical text to improve early delirium prediction while falling back to structured-only prediction when text is missing.
clinical_relevance: Earlier identification of patients at risk for delirium could support timely clinical assessment, though clinical benefit was not established in the abstract.
method: A temporal Transformer encodes structured EHR time series.
A clinical text encoder processes time-stamped radiology reports.
Gated cross-attention learns patient-specific text weights and closes the gate when notes are absent.
evidence_signal: On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, the authors report significant gains over baselines, especially for patients with text, with no performance loss reported for those without; ablations support the fusion design.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical performance estimates or external validation, leaving the size and generalizability of gains uncertain.
paper_title: DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction
